## Pass sequence

1. Read all touched files and their call sites.
2. Write shared data and adapters.
3. Enrich player and enemy catalogs.
4. Wire authoritative receipts and local authority.
5. Re-read every touched file.
6. Compare planned versus actual and write a delta file.
7. Complete missing production wiring.
8. Add tests and run focused verification.
9. Expand to HUD, effects, persistence, Warden, environment, loading, builds, and browser acceptance.
10. Perform final audit and close only when remaining work is empty.
